    },

      "id": "L005",
      "text": "No CSP header present in HTTP response."

Return ONLY one valid JSON object matching the AgentTurnOutput schema.

- private_notes (string; hidden from other agents)
- private_plan (string; hidden from other agents)
- public_message (string; shared)
- assessment (object with ranked_findings [ranks 1..3], decision_summary)
